description.en: Income support for small and marginal farmer families, paid in three yearly instalments.
description.hi: छोटे और सीमांत किसान परिवारों के लिए वार्षिक आय सहायता, तीन किस्तों में।

eligibility: Small or marginal farmer family with cultivable land
Aadhaar-linked bank account
Land records in the applicant's name

name.hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना

description.en: Health cover for eligible families for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
description.hi: पात्र परिवारों के लिए द्वितीयक और तृतीयक अस्पताल इलाज हेतु स्वास्थ्य बीमा।

benefits: Up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
eligibility: Household listed in SECC deprivation criteria or eligible state database
No upper age limit
Aadhaar for identification

description.en: Assistance to build a pucca house for houseless families and those living in kutcha houses in rural areas.
description.hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बेघर और कच्चे घरों में रहने वाले परिवारों के लिए पक्का घर बनाने हेतु सहायता।

benefits: Support for toilet and electricity connections
eligibility: Rural household without a pucca house
Name in the SECC 2011 housing deprivation list or state-approved list
No existing pucca house in the family

description.en: Guaranteed wage employment for rural households, with a statutory right to 100 days of work per year.
description.hi: ग्रामीण परिवारों को वर्ष में 100 दिन के काम का कानूनी अधिकार और मजदूरी।

benefits: Up to 100 days of paid work per household per year
Unemployment allowance if work is not provided
Equal wages for men and women
eligibility: Rural household with adult members
Willing to do unskilled manual work
Resident of the gram panchayat

description.en: Deposit-free LPG connections for women from eligible poor households.
description.hi: पात्र गरीब परिवारों की महिलाओं के लिए बिना जमा राशि के एलपीजी कनेक्शन।

benefits: First refill and stove support in some cases
eligibility: Adult woman from a BPL or eligible household
No existing LPG connection in the household
Aadhaar-linked bank account

description.en: Small savings scheme for a girl child with a long-term maturity benefit.
description.hi: बालिका के लिए दीर्घकालिक बचत योजना।

benefits: Fixed interest rate set by the government
Deposits from ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh per year
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age
Account opened by a parent or legal guardian
Maximum two accounts per family in most cases

description.en: Government-backed pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector.
description.hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों के लिए सरकार समर्थित पेंशन योजना।

benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 per month after 60
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 to 40
Savings bank or post office account
Not an income-tax payer in most cases

name.hi: राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम - विधवा पेंशन

description.en: Monthly pension for widows from below-poverty-line households under the National Social Assistance Programme.
description.hi: राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम के तहत गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के परिवारों की विधवाओं के लिए मासिक पेंशन।

benefits: Monthly pension credited to the bank account
eligibility: Widow aged 18 to 79
Below-poverty-line household
Not receiving another NSAP pension

name.hi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति विद्यार्थियों हेतु पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

description.en: Scholarship support for SC/ST students pursuing education after Class 10.
description.hi: कक्षा 10 के बाद पढ़ाई कर रहे अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति विद्यार्थियों के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।

eligibility: SC or ST student
Enrolled in a recognised post-matriculation course
Family income within the scheme limit

name.hi: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम राशन कार्ड

description.en: Subsidised food grain for eligible households under the National Food Security Act.
description.hi: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम के तहत पात्र परिवारों को रियायती अनाज।

benefits: Portability through One Nation One Ration Card
eligibility: Eligible household under state NFSA criteria
No existing ration card in another state for the same family
Aadhaar for each adult member

description.en: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople, including loans, training and toolkit incentives.
description.hi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों और शिल्पकारों के लिए ऋण, प्रशिक्षण और टूलकिट सहायता।

benefits: Toolkit incentive and digital transaction support
eligibility: Traditional artisan or craftsperson in a listed trade
Age 18 or above
Not availed a similar central scheme loan recently

description.en: National database registration for unorganised workers, used to access welfare schemes.
description.hi: असंगठित श्रमिकों का राष्ट्रीय डेटाबेस पंजीकरण, कल्याण योजनाओं के लिए।

benefits: Easier access to eligible welfare schemes
eligibility: Unorganised sector worker aged 16 to 59
Not a member of EPFO or ESIC
Aadhaar-linked mobile number
